plugins.name: redact-secrets
plugins.description: Replaces the values of TOKEN, PASSWORD and PWD environment variables in every conversation row.

plugins.name: ideas-pane
plugins.description: Ideas backlog from the Notes vault in a side pane: click to grill, capture while working.

plugins.name: cache-meter
plugins.description: Band above the prompt: cache time left, hit rate, context weather and a Compact button.

plugins.name: speak
plugins.description: Reads Claude's answers aloud via OpenRouter TTS (Gemini), on demand with /speak or automatically.

plugins.name: model-router
plugins.description: Picks the model for a session from its first prompt via a decision model on OpenRouter.

plugins.name: project-guard
plugins.description: Asks before a prompt goes to the wrong project session: keywords of another project, none of this one's.
